notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-ignore-error (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): IGNORE CONDITION, HANDLE CONDITION ERROR and PUSH / POP HANDLE around one LENGERR, and POP HANDLE's INVREQ. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: ignored
scenarios.why: IGNORE CONDITION LENGERR: control goes on after the RECEIVE, EIBRESP 22

scenarios.name: error-label
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION ERROR only: LENGERR has no action of its own and its default is an abend, so ERROR's label

scenarios.name: own-before-error
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION ERROR and LENGERR: LENGERR's own label

scenarios.name: ignore-before-error
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION ERROR, IGNORE CONDITION LENGERR: the IGNORE, not ERROR

scenarios.name: push-suspends-ignore
scenarios.why: IGNORE CONDITION LENGERR, PUSH HANDLE: the IGNORE is suspended, LENGERR's default action abends the task (AEIV)

scenarios.name: pop-restores-ignore
scenarios.why: IGNORE CONDITION LENGERR, PUSH HANDLE, POP HANDLE: ignored again

scenarios.name: pop-nothing-pushed
scenarios.why: POP HANDLE with nothing pushed: INVREQ, which has no label of its own, so ERROR's

scenarios.name: ignore-overrides-handle
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION LENGERR then IGNORE CONDITION LENGERR: the IGNORE overrides it

scenarios.name: push-suspends-error
scenarios.why: HANDLE CONDITION ERROR, PUSH HANDLE: ERROR's label is suspended, LENGERR abends the task (AEIV)
